_comment: Recurring-failure scenarios for the offline memory-shortcut eval. Each task is a failure an agent hits AGAIN, whose fix already lives in benchmarks/corpus.json. `command` + `stored_error` seed the past failure into command_runs (so a fingerprint exists); `error_text` is the near-identical stderr the agent RE-hits (drifted line numbers/paths — the fingerprint must survive normalization); `query` is how an agent might ask about it (search_memory path); `fix_ids` are the corpus memory id(s) whose text STATES THE RESOLUTION. fix_ids were labelled BLIND from corpus.json alone, before any retrieval was run (see benchmarks/SHORTCUT_EVAL.md). Any tokens/keys are OBVIOUSLY fake.

tasks.query: camera driver fails to compile, expected u16 found u32 in decode_pixel
tasks.why: corpus #2 states the fix (cast back to u16 with `as u16`); #1 records only the error.
